competences.description: Attacks the enemy and creates a Shield equal to 10% of your MAX HP on the ally with the worst HP condition for 2 turns.

effets.description: The Shield will absorb a fixed amount of damage.

competences.description: Creates a Shield equal to 20% of your MAX HP on all allies for 2 turns and grants them Reflect Damage for 2 turns.

effets.description: The Shield will absorb a fixed amount of damage.
The target will return 30% of the incoming damage to the attacker when attacked.

competences.description: Removes all harmful effects on all allies and increases their Attack Bar by 30%. In addition, if the skill is not on cooldown at the moment of death, revives with 30% HP and activates {rp_gandalf_3_light_ex}. {rp_gandalf_3_light_ex} is maintained until the battle ends.

effets.description: The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.
Removes all harmful effects on all allies, increases their Attack Bar by 30%, and revives all allies with 30% HP. The cooldown increases by 2 turns per revived ally.
